rows.note: Use 一部分 as the all-purpose everyday way to refer to one divided piece when the subdivision structure need not be stressed.

example.english: This piece is only one subdivision of the whole cake, not the whole thing.
example.traditional: 呢塊蛋糕只係成個蛋糕嘅一部分，唔係全部。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 daan6 gou1 zi2 hai6 seng4 go3 daan6 gou1 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6 m4 hai6 cyun4 bou6

rows.note: Use 分部 for a distinct subdivision of an organisation, system, or administrative structure.

example.english: The Hong Kong subdivision of this company hired many people this year.
example.traditional: 呢間公司嘅香港分部今年請咗好多人。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 fan1 bou6 gam1 nin4 ceng2 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4

rows.note: Use 細分 for the further division of something that has already been divided, especially in technical or business contexts.

example.english: After the market subdivision, we grouped people by age.
example.traditional: 做完市場細分之後，我哋再按年齡分組。
example.jyutping: zou6 jyun4 si5 coeng4 sai3 fan1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 zoi3 on3 nin4 ling4 fan1 zou2
